newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures ease in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures ease in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were weaker in after-hours trade on Friday, in a technical correction after prices posted robust gains during the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.1 yen to 1.0 yen per gram easier than the day's close. Benchmark July was down 1.0 yen at 157.4 yen.

During the day, prices crawled up, backed by the yen's continued fall against the dollar. The dollar rose as high as 124.30 yen in early afternoon trade, its highest level in four years. "The rubber price rises this week were too rapid, and the market may face a moderate technical correction next week," one trader said.
